title: Protective effects of triptolide against oxidative stress in retinal pigment epithelium cells via the PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 pathway: a network pharmacological method and experimental validation.
authors: Pan, Fuying; Shu, Qinxin; Xie, Hao; Zhao, Long; Wu, Ping; Du, Yong; Lu, Jing; He, Yuxia; Wang, Xing; Peng, Hui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究雷公藤甲素通过PI3K/AKT/Nrf2通路保护视网膜色素上皮细胞氧化损伤，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是细胞氧化应激而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Among aging adults, age-related macular degeneration (AMD), is a prevalent cause of blindness. Nevertheless, its progression may be halted by antioxidation in retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). The primary effective constituent of Tripterygium wilfordii Hook. F., triptolide (TP), has demonstrated anti-inflammatory, antiproliferative, and antioxidant properties. The mechanics of the protective effect of triptolide against the oxidative damage in retinal pigment epithelial (RPE) were assessed in this study. METHODS: ARPE-19 cells were pretreated with TP, and then exposed to sodium iodate (SI). First, cell viability was assessed using CCK-8. Subsequently, we measured indicators for cell oxidation including reactive oxygen species (ROS), catalase (CAT), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and malondialdehyde (MDA). Then, we used network pharmacological analysis and molecular docking to explore the signaling pathway of TP. Last, we used western blot, ELISA, and immunofluorescence assays to clarify the potential mechanistic pathways. RESULTS: The network pharmacology data suggested that TP may inhibit AMD by regulating the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. Experimental results showed that the potential mechanism is that it regulates the PI3K/Akt pathway and promotes Nrf2 phosphorylation and activation, thereby raising the level of antioxidant factors (HO-1, NQO1) and reducing the generation of ROS, which inhibit oxidative damage. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggested that the effect of TP on SI-exposed RPE cells principally relies on the regulation of oxidative stress through the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：在老年人中，年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）是导致失明的常见原因。然而，其进展可能通过视网膜色素上皮（RPE）中的抗氧化作用而得到遏制。雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii Hook. F.）的主要有效成分雷公藤甲素（triptolide, TP）已显示出抗炎、抗增殖和抗氧化特性。本研究评估了雷公藤甲素对视网膜色素上皮（RPE）细胞氧化损伤保护作用的机制。方法：ARPE-19细胞经TP预处理，然后暴露于碘酸钠（SI）。首先，使用CCK-8评估细胞活力。随后，我们测量了细胞氧化指标，包括活性氧（ROS）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和丙二醛（MDA）。接着，我们使用网络药理学分析和分子对接来探索TP的信号通路。最后，我们使用蛋白质印迹、ELISA和免疫荧光实验来阐明潜在的机制通路。结果：网络药理学数据提示，TP可能通过调节PI3K/Akt信号通路来抑制AMD。实验结果表明，其潜在机制是调节PI3K/Akt通路并促进Nrf2磷酸化和激活，从而提高抗氧化因子（HO-1、NQO1）水平并减少ROS生成，从而抑制氧化损伤。结论：我们的研究结果表明，TP对SI暴露的RPE细胞的作用主要依赖于通过PI3K/Akt/Nrf2信号通路调节氧化应激。
